metadata.name: tunnel
metadata.description: TUNNEL — Quantum Tunneling Protocol on Solana

accounts.name: owner_token_account
docs: The owner's $TUNNEL associated token account. Only required when the
payout is non-zero (clients create it idempotently in the same tx).

accounts.name: gatekeeper
docs: Required (and must match `protocol.gatekeeper`) only when a gatekeeper is configured.

accounts.name: program
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize, which prevents
anyone front-running initialization with their own config.

accounts.name: vrf_request
docs: that a cycle whose randomness is already public can only be revealed.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not the protocol admin

errors.name: ZeroParticles
errors.msg: Particle count must be greater than zero

errors.name: EnergyExhausted
errors.msg: Not enough particle energy left in this cycle

errors.name: CycleNotOpen
errors.msg: Cycle is not open for deployments

errors.name: CycleStillOpen
errors.msg: Cycle deployment window is still running

errors.name: CycleScheduleConflict
errors.msg: The next cycle cannot be scheduled yet

errors.name: SlotHashesUnavailable
errors.msg: Slot hashes sysvar is unavailable or malformed

errors.name: RandomnessNotFulfilled
errors.msg: Randomness has not been fulfilled yet

errors.name: RandomnessAccountMismatch
errors.msg: Randomness account does not match the cycle request

errors.name: PositionsPending
errors.msg: Not every position has been settled

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: No pending admin, or signer is not the pending admin

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: CycleMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not belong to this cycle

errors.name: RandomnessAvailable
errors.msg: Randomness is available; reveal it instead of voiding the cycle

errors.name: GatekeeperRequired
errors.msg: This deployment must be co-signed by the protocol gatekeeper

errors.name: TokenAccountRequired
errors.msg: A $TUNNEL token account is required to receive a non-zero reward

types.name: BarrierConfig
docs: One rectangular potential barrier. Values are thousandths of the
normalized units in which ħ²/2m = 1 (for an electron: 1 length unit = 1 Å,
1 energy unit ≈ 3.81 eV).

fields.name: height_milli
docs: Barrier height V₀ × 1000.

fields.name: width_milli
docs: Barrier width a × 1000.

fields.name: reward_premium_bps
docs: Expected reward per energy unit relative to par (10000 = par).

fields.name: total_nominal
docs: Σ successes × nominal reward over every position.

fields.name: tokens_allocated
docs: min(total_nominal, emission_budget): what claims can pay in total.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 1 = Rewards, 2 = NoTunnels, 3 = Void, 4 = Empty

fields.name: reason
docs: 0 = never closed, 1 = randomness timeout

types.name: EnergyLevel
docs: A particle energy setting a user can choose.

fields.name: energy_bps
docs: Particle energy E as a fraction of the barrier height (bps of V₀).

fields.name: cost
docs: Energy units drawn from the wallet's per-cycle allowance per particle.

types.name: OddsTable
docs: Odds and nominal rewards derived by the program from `ProtocolParams`:
the physics model fixes each probability, and each reward is calibrated
to it. Nobody can set these directly.

fields.name: transmission_ppb
docs: Tunneling probability per [barrier][level], parts per billion.

fields.name: reward
docs: Nominal $TUNNEL base units per successful particle, per [barrier][level].

types.name: ParticlesDeployed
docs: One experiment: a single `deploy_particles` call.

fields.name: experiment
docs: Sequence number of this experiment within the wallet's position (0-based).

fields.name: first_index
docs: Draw index of the first particle; particles use `first_index..first_index+count`.

fields.name: height_milli
docs: Physical inputs of this attempt (from the cycle snapshot): V₀×1000, a×1000, E/V₀ in bps.

types.name: Position
docs: One wallet's particles in one cycle. Created on the first deployment,
closed (rent returned) on claim.

fields.name: particles
docs: Particles per [barrier][level]. Particle `i` of a cell is drawn with index `i`.

fields.name: experiments
docs: Number of `deploy_particles` calls (experiments) in this position.

fields.name: gatekeeper
docs: When not the default key, every `deploy_particles` must be co-signed by
this key (an operator rate-limiting service). Disabled by default.

fields.name: params
docs: Parameters applied to cycles opened from now on. Open cycles keep their snapshot.

fields.name: reserve_available
docs: $TUNNEL in the reward vault that is not yet committed to any cycle.

fields.name: energy_per_cycle
docs: Free particle-energy allowance per wallet per cycle. Unused energy expires.

fields.name: reward_per_energy
docs: $TUNNEL base units paid per energy unit at par odds (before premium and caps).

fields.name: initial_emission_per_cycle
docs: $TUNNEL base units budgeted for cycle 0's epoch.

fields.name: emission_decay_bps
docs: Multiplier applied once per epoch (9950 = emission × 0.995 each epoch).
